Privacy Policy

Last Updated 24 Jan 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Cypher Capital (BVI) Limited and its affiliates collect, use, and share your personal information.

01—Information We Collect

1.1 Information You Provide

We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, submit an enquiry, subscribe to our newsletter, or otherwise communicate with us. This information may include your name, email address, phone number, company name, and any other information you choose to provide.

1.2 Automatically Collected Information

When you access or use our website, we automatically collect certain information, including your IP address, browser type, operating system, referring URLs, and information about how you interact with our website.

02—How We Use Your Information

2.1 Purpose of Use

We use the information we collect to: provide, maintain, and improve our services; respond to your inquiries and requests; send you technical notices, updates, and administrative messages; communicate with you about products, services, and events; and comply with legal obligations.

03—Information Sharing

3.1 Third Parties

We may share your information with third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as hosting, data analysis, customer service, and marketing assistance. We may also share information when required by law or to protect our rights.

04—Data Security

4.1 Security Measures

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

05—Your Rights

5.1 Access and Control

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information, including the right to access, correct, delete, or port your data. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

06—Contact Us

6.1 Questions

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at legal@cyphercapital.com.
